cues.description: Pointer enters a menu button, list row or combo box entry.
cues.wanted: Very short, dry felt/parchment brush. Under 80 ms, no pitch content.

cues.description: Menu button, list row or combo box entry is activated.
cues.wanted: Firm wood-on-leather confirm tap with a small low-mid body.

cues.description: Player leaves a screen or cancels a dialog.
cues.wanted: Descending two-tone cancel blip, softer and darker than ui.click.

cues.description: Player switches between tabs or side panels.
cues.wanted: Short parchment slide, slightly brighter than ui.click.

cues.description: A panel, settings sheet or overlay opens.
cues.wanted: Leather scroll unrolling, ~250 ms, rising.

cues.description: A panel, settings sheet or overlay closes.
cues.wanted: Leather scroll rolling shut, ~250 ms, falling. Pairs with ui.panel_open.

cues.description: A checkbox, switch or mode toggle changes state.
cues.wanted: Small bronze latch click, two variants for on and off would be ideal.

cues.description: The UI refuses an action (disabled control, invalid input).
cues.wanted: Dull, muted double thud. Must not read as a normal click.

cues.description: Move order issued to the current selection.
cues.wanted: Short kit shuffle: leather, mail rustle, a single boot scuff.

cues.description: Attack order issued against a picked target.
cues.wanted: Sharp single horn stab, dry and close, no reverb tail.

cues.description: Patrol route confirmed between two waypoints.
cues.wanted: Two-note horn phrase, calmer than order.attack.

cues.description: Stop order cancels the current activity.
cues.wanted: Single muted drum hit, abrupt cut.

cues.description: Hold-position mode toggled on the selection.
cues.wanted: Shields planting into dirt, one short thud.

cues.description: Guard mode toggled on the selection.
cues.wanted: Spear butt tapped twice on hard ground.

cues.description: Run mode toggled on the selection.
cues.wanted: Quick kit rattle plus a short breath, suggesting a change of pace.

cues.description: Formation placement mode entered or left.
cues.wanted: Light standard pole shift, cloth snap.

cues.description: Formation ghost committed at the chosen position and angle.
cues.wanted: Standard driven into the ground, single decisive thud.

cues.description: Gate command mode changes (open, close, auto).
cues.wanted: Short iron bolt slide.

cues.description: Rally point placed for a production building.
cues.wanted: Small banner flap plus a peg driven into soil.

cues.description: Construction preview refuses the requested site.
cues.wanted: Dry refusal thunk, shared family with ui.error but shorter.

cues.description: A builder begins work on a construction site.
cues.wanted: Mallet on stake, saw start, brief crowd of work sounds. ~1 s.

cues.description: A construction site finishes and becomes a real building.
cues.wanted: Timber settling into place plus a two-second warm confirmation phrase.

cues.description: A unit is added to a production queue.
cues.wanted: Wax tablet stylus scratch, very short.

cues.description: A produced unit leaves the barracks.
cues.wanted: Single low barracks bell. Must sit under the unit voice line that plays with it.

cues.description: A building, wall segment or gate is destroyed.
cues.wanted: Timber and masonry collapse with a rubble tail, ~2.5 s.

cues.description: A wall gate swings open.
cues.wanted: Heavy wooden gate on iron hinges, opening, ~1.5 s.

cues.description: A wall gate swings shut and bars.
cues.wanted: Gate shutting plus bar drop. Pairs with build.gate_open.

cues.description: An action failed for lack of resources or manpower.
Troop limit reached, production refused.
A building owned by the local player is taking damage.
The local player captures a barrack and gains reinforcements.
The enemy captures a barrack the local player held.
A mission objective is satisfied (for example an undead zone is cleared).
cues.wanted: Short rising three-note brass figure, confident, ~1.5 s.

cues.description: The mission is lost, failing its remaining objectives.
cues.wanted: Short falling brass figure, dark. Mirrors alert.objective_complete.

cues.description: Sword or gladius lands on a shield or body.
Spear or javelin lands.
Arrow lands on a shield, armour or dirt.
Mounted attack connects.
War elephant attack connects.
Catapult or ballista shot connects.
cues.wanted: A dedicated stone-on-wood siege impact would replace this crowd bed.

cues.description: Fallback impact for unit types with no dedicated family.
A troop dies.
An archer looses an arrow.
cues.wanted: A single dry bow release, isolated. The current clip is a group recording.

cues.description: A projectile lands close enough to read as an arrow passing.
A mass of arrows crosses overhead.
A catapult or ballista releases.
cues.wanted: Torsion release: rope creak, wooden arm slam against the stop, ~1 s.

cues.description: A siege projectile lands.
cues.wanted: Stone striking earth or timber with a debris tail, ~1.5 s.

cues.description: A selected body of troops is switched into run mode and breaks into a charge.
cues.wanted: A dedicated charge roar layered with running feet, faction-neutral.

cues.description: A healer restores health to an ally.
cues.wanted: Warm, quiet, non-magical: water poured, cloth binding, a soft exhale.

cues.description: The local player wins the mission.
The local player loses the mission.
